senses.gloss: f. pl. (צָפָה; cmp. b. h. מכורות, fr. כרה) (also used as sing.) a tube for measuring distances, a sort of telescope.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Eruvin 5:3:3">Y. Erub. V, 22ᵈ</cite> top [read:] <he>מביא מ׳ ומשער וכ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="M01317"><he>מֵישַׁר</he></cite> (cmp.

<cite ref="Tosefta Eiruvin 6:13">Tosef. Erub. VI</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Eiruvin 5:13">V</cite>), 13). Y. ib. IV, 21ᵈ bot. <he>מ׳ היו לו וכ׳</he> (not <he>מצודות</he>) he had a telescope &c. (Bab. ib. 43ᵇ <cite ref="U01724"><he>שפופרת</he></cite>), v. <cite ref="M01317"><he>מֵישַׁר</he></cite>.
